newsitem.title: UK: CNA to launch up to $2.0 bln FFR domestic bond.
newsitem.headline: CNA to launch up to $2.0 bln FFR domestic bond.

text.p: Caisse Nationale des Autoroutes will launch a long-dated domestic French franc bond next week, syndicate officials in Paris said.
"The maturity will be for 10 years or more, and the amount for between 1.0 and 2.0 billion French francs ($351.3 million)," a syndicate official said.
"There will be a tender on Monday or Tuesday, and all French banks are in the running to lead manage the transaction," he said.
CNA last launched a 2.5 billion French franc bond in late January, with a January 2009 maturity to yield 11 basis points over French government paper.
CNA is rated AAA by both Moody's Investors Service and Standard & Poor's Corp.
-- Hayley Pienaar, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7718 ($ = 5.692 French Francs)
